description: Check domain name availability via RDAP (with a whois fallback), with zero dependencies. Use whenever the user wants to know if a domain is free, compare a name across many TLDs, or find an available domain for a project/brand. Triggers on: "is X.com available", "check domain", "is this domain taken", "find a domain for", "domain availability", "je domena volna", "zkontroluj domenu", "najdi volnou domenu", or naming/branding tasks that need a registrable domain.
